results.title: A Tailor-Made Romance
results.overview: A struggling designer takes a job as a personal stylist for a grumpy but ridiculously handsome billionaire. As she revamps his wardrobe and he teaches her about business, they realize they just might be the perfect fit.

results.title: Labyrinth
results.overview: A group of strangers are brought together under mysterious circumstances by a nefarious leader to be judged for their past transgressions in a facility designed to test their mettle against a gauntlet of deadly challenges. Most will fall while others find redemption in this action-packed descent into Hell.

results.title: Parrisu
results.overview: Parrisu is a tamil movie starring Jaanvekaa Subramaniam and Kiran Pradeep  in prominent roles. It is directed by Kala Alluri.

results.title: Escambrón, playa
results.overview: Explore the area of Escambrón Beach in San Juan, Puerto Rico, as residents come together to protect its coastline from overdevelopment.

results.title: Love Potion
results.overview: A young chemistry student dreams of creating a “Love Potion” that would capture the hearts of girls all over the world. But after an unsuccessful experiment, an unexpected event occurs, turning his fate in a direction he never could have imagined.

results.title: King Kenny
results.overview: Kenny Dalglish came to Liverpool from Celtic in 1977 with a huge task, to try and replace Keegan in an all-conquering championship winning team. To say he did so with skill, charm and ability is an understatement as he went on to win every honour in the game, manage the club to every possible trophy and steer them through its darkest hour. A true great of the game.

results.title: Love Marriage
results.overview: Ram, a 33-year-old Bachelor From Madurai, Faces Mounting Pressure to Get Married. Amidst Cultural Expectations and Comic Misadventures, He Embarks on a Journey of Self-discovery, Questioning Tradition and Seeking His Own Path to Happiness

results.title: Gunplay
results.overview: In a world of crime bosses, harmless henchman Garry keeps hostages at gunpoint as a threat to those who mean to harm a boss. When Garry's position is threatened, will he betray his moral position and kill the hostage, or do what's right?

results.title: The Night Screams at the Cabin
results.original_title: The Night Screams at the Cabin
results.overview: Julia (Ashleigh Amberlynn), the final girl, returns one more time to finish off Anthony (Josh Ortiz) and Chad (Robert Angelo) for good with the help of Uncle Tommy (Joel Frady) and Sam (Chris Correa)!

results.title: Amy Macdonald - Baloise Session 2025
results.overview: A key figure in modern folk rock, Amy Macdonald captivates audiences with her haunting melodies and unique voice. Her sixth album, Is This What You've Been Waiting For?, continues her musical odyssey. On stage, the singer exudes boundless energy and irresistible charm.

results.title: Limp
results.overview: During PE at a Cornish secondary School, the new kid tries to hide who he is on the basketball court.

results.title: Royal Family - Hollands königliche Geschwister
results.overview: They are the most famous sisters in the Netherlands: the so-called “A-Team”—Amalia, Alexia, and Ariane, the daughters of King Willem-Alexander and Queen Máxima. As they come of age, the younger daughters are also drawing public attention. However, only the eldest, Princess Amalia, bears any responsibility. Her path is predetermined as the future Queen of the Netherlands. Princess Alexia and Princess Ariane, however, have a choice. Will they dedicate themselves to serving the royal family, like their great-aunt Margriet, for whom this has been a life’s work for more than 60 years? Or will they follow the example of King Willem-Alexander’s brothers, who went their own way as “freelance royals”?

results.title: Céline Dion raconte D'eux
results.overview: Thirty years after the release of the album "D'eux", Céline Dion agreed to speak out and reflect on this iconic work.  Between intimate confidences and surprising revelations, the singer offers us privileged access to this pivotal moment in her career and a unique moment in her life.

results.title: Notes from a Fish
results.overview: An aspiring novelist on the verge of a publishing breakthrough loses his unconventional muse, a tropical fish, sending him and an unstable fisheries officer on a series of bizarre misadventures in search of the fish rumoured to hold mysterious, almost magical powers.

results.title: The Savior of the World
results.original_title: 魔道天师: 幽冥黄泉
results.overview: An ancient demon is reborn after a hundred years, intent on uniting the three realms under its rule. Disciples of the Celestial Master Sect rise up in resistance. In its final moments, the demon transfers its soul into the body of the sect's future leader, Wang Xian Zhi, waiting for the right moment to return.  As an adult, Wang Xian Zhi sets out to suppress the demon's power. Alongside his close friends Zhu Yan and Xiao Ling’er, he journeys to Banbu Duo in search of the legendary artifact that can seal the demon - the Supreme Heavenly Tome. After enduring countless hardships, the trio finally reaches Wangchuan, only to face an even greater threat.  Jiang Fang Mu, driven by his desire to claim the position of sect leader, summons a deadly enchantress to eliminate them. Once again, the three find themselves in grave danger. Will their quest for the Heavenly Tome be able to continue?

results.title: Ghosts of Alderney: Hitler's Island Slaves
results.original_title: Ghosts of Alderney: Hitler's Island Slaves
results.overview: Visual artist Piers Secunda seeks out Hitler's Island Slaves. Meeting families of survivors, Secunda finds new forensic evidence of murder, brutality and a British government cover-up following the Nazi reign of terror on British soil.

results.title: Milarepa
results.overview: In Sardinia, in the near future, the ancient settlements come back to life, once again hosting man. The young Mila is robbed of her father's inheritance by her paternal uncles. After many adventures she manages to obtain revenge. Despite this, the girl still struggles to find serenity and therefore decides to undertake a spiritual journey in search of herself.
